parameters.help_en: The voice used for corpus playback. The voice is preset by the system, such as standard female voice and standard male voice. You can query the available voice types by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217887.html and specify the Value from the VoiceList response parameter
parameters.help_zh: 语料播报声音，由系统预设，例如标准女声、标准男声等。可以选择的声音类型通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217887.html进行查询，填入返回参数中**VoiceList**中**Value**的值
parameters.name: voice

parameters.help_en:
The corpus type. The corpus is classified into custom corpus and common corpus.

If you do not specify this parameter or set it to custom, you must specify the Text and BizCode parameters. Otherwise, the call fails.

Custom corpus (default): Set the value to custom. For a custom corpus, you must specify the corpus identifier and corpus text.
Common corpus: The common corpus text preset by the system. This includes the following types:
    - Numbers: Set the value to number. This includes the numbers 0 to 9, dot, and yao.
    - Measure words: Set the value to measure_word. This includes piece, ten, hundred, thousand, ten thousand, hundred thousand, million, and hundred million.
    - Currency units: Set the value to monetary_unit. This includes fen, jiao, and yuan.
    - Time units: Set the value to time_unit. This includes hour, minute, second, month, day, and year.
    - Unit time: Set the value to unit_time. This includes per second, per minute, per hour, per day, per week, per month, and per year.
    - Length units: Set the value to length_unit. This includes millimeter, centimeter, decimeter, meter, kilometer, inch, foot, and mile
parameters.help_zh:
语料类型，分为自定义语料和常用语料。

不传入此参数时或传入custom，必须传入参数Text和BizCode，否则调用会失败。

自定义语料（默认）：取值为custom，是自定义语料时，必须填写语料标识和语料文本。
常用语料：由系统预置的常用语料文本，包括以下类型：
    - 数字：取值为number，包含：数字0~9，点，幺。
    - 量词：取值为measure_word，包含：个，十，百，千，万，十万，百万，亿等。
    - 货币单位：取值为monetary_unit，包含：分，角，元等。
    - 时间单位：取值为time_unit，包含：时，分，秒，月，日，年等。
    - 单位时间：取值为unit_time，包含：每秒，每分，每小时，每天，每周，每月，每年等。
    - 长度单位：取值为length_unit，包含：毫米，厘米，分米，米，千米，公里，英寸，英尺，英里等
parameters.name: speech_type

parameters.help_en:
The corpus identifier. When a device calls multiple corpora for combined playback, this identifier is used to play the specified corpus.

If you set SpeechType to custom, this parameter is required. The corpus identifier is custom and supports letters and digits. It must be 1 to 32 characters in length and unique within the project. We recommend that you use the first letters of the pinyin of the corpus semantics as the corpus identifier. For example, set the identifier to `ZFDZ` for `Payment received`.

If you set SpeechType to common corpus, the corpus identifier is automatically generated by the system. You do not need to specify it
parameters.help_zh:
语料标识，当设备调用多个语料进行组合播报时，通过该标识播报指定的语料。

当语料类型选择为自定义语料时，该参数必选。语料标识由用户自定义，支持英文字母和数字，长度为1~32个字符，项目下保证唯一。建议将语料语义的拼音首字母设置为语料标识，例如：`支付到账`设置为`ZFDZ`。

当语料类型选择为常用语料时，语料标识由系统自动生成，无需用户自定义

parameters.help_en: The corpus text. This parameter is required if you set the corpus type to custom corpus. The corpus text supports letters, Chinese characters, and spaces. It must be 1 to 100 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as two characters

parameters.help_en:
The sound code configuration. This includes the following fields:


SoundCodeContent: The sound code marketing content, such as the product detail URL.

AdditionalDuration: The playback duration of the sound code after the corpus playback ends. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 15
parameters.help_zh:
声码配置，包含字段如下：


SoundCodeContent：声码营销内容，例如商品的详情地址等。

AdditionalDuration：语料播放结束后的声码播放时长，单位为秒，取值范围为1～15
